title: AI Extraction Annotation
description: Ground truth annotations for AI extraction quality evaluation. NO PII stored — document_id is an internal DB key only.

document_id.description: Internal AI DB document_id (EmployeeDocument PK). Not a name or IIN.

annotator_id.description: Operator identifier (not full name). E.g. 'op1' or 'reviewer_A'.

fields.description: Per-field ground truth. Keys must be EXTRACTABLE_FIELDS.

applicable.description: Is this field expected to be in this document type?

present.description: Was the value actually in the document (human-verified)?

ai_extracted.description: Did the AI produce a non-null value for this field?

ai_correct.description: Was the AI extraction correct? null if not applicable.

findings.description: Per-finding-code ground truth. Keys are issue_code values.

expected.description: Should this finding be raised for this document?

detected.description: Did the AI raise this finding?
